changesRequestedReviews.author: architect
changesRequestedReviews.body: The overall architecture needs to be reconsidered before merging.

instructions: Review each item under `## Changes-requested reviews` and decide whether it needs a code change.
Read every body under `## Changes-requested reviews` and apply any warranted change.
If you changed code, commit any remaining changes and push. Otherwise, do not commit or push.
For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`.
Link threads and comments from their headings. Cite reviews by ID.

`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, continue with the next poll using the same interface and mode: rerun the current `pr-shepherd` CLI invocation with its flags, or call MCP `iterate` again.
